purpose: Teach: 参事官/占有/便宜/納付/受託/公然/始動/散会

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯参事官の制度をご紹介します
lines.en: I'd like to introduce the crime prevention counselor system we have in place.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear articulation on key terms. Steady pace, no rush. The opening of a prepared explanation — respectful and direct, as if reading from careful notes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、押収物の占有期間を明示されますね
lines.en: Yes. So the police do make the duration of held seized items clear to people.
lines.style: Attentive, confirming. Slight rise at the end — checking understanding, not challenging. Warmer than procedural — he's engaged, not just listening. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民に便宜を図る制度を運用しております
lines.en: We operate systems designed to make things more convenient for citizens.
lines.style: Steady, official register. Even pace. Slight emphasis on 'designed' — pride in the framework. Not cold, but formal. The voice of institutional care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。罰金の納付状況を警察、把握ですね
lines.en: Yes. So the police do keep track of fine payment status across the region.
lines.style: Following along, respectful confirmation. Light lift on the question — checking his own understanding aloud, not doubting. Warm but deferential to the officer's authority.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、受託捜査の体制を整えております
lines.en: We've put the infrastructure in place to handle commissioned investigations from other jurisdictions.
lines.style: Continuing the formal briefing tone. Slight emphasis on 'infrastructure' — showing substance behind the words. Steady delivery, confident without being boastful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、公然たる発表が地域に安心感を与えますね
lines.en: Yes. Public announcements from the police really do give the community a sense of security.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Slight nod in the voice — he sees the value of what's being described. Not just tracking information; genuinely appreciating the reassurance it provides.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新指揮系統を始動いたしました
lines.en: We've activated the new command structure as planned.
lines.style: Final statement of briefing. Slight closure — the 'as planned' delivered with quiet satisfaction. Professional but warmer than the opening; the briefing has landed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議が無事散会して、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful the meeting concluded smoothly.
lines.style: Closing note of genuine thanks. Softer attack. The exhaustion of a long meeting lifting slightly. He means this — relief and appreciation in equal measure, delivered with quiet sincerity.
